title: Refactor SRD parsers to consume bounded source spans
description:
Problem

Multiple audit findings point to parser boundary failures:

- Every subclass record description appears to swallow its subclass feature headings and feature bodies.
- magic-item:feather-token swallows the following Figurine of Wondrous Power entry.
- Flattened descriptions are masking places where structured records or child objects should exist.

These are not isolated content mistakes; they indicate that parsers are consuming source spans with brittle stop conditions.

Depends on

This should build on the source inventory/coverage gate bead if possible. The coverage gate should expose the incorrect spans and provide regression cases.

Task

Refactor SRD importer parsing so major record parsers consume explicitly bounded source spans derived from the source structure inventory or equivalent deterministic heading map.

Parser spans should be explicit for at least:

- classes,
- subclasses,
- class features,
- subclass features,
- magic items,
- rules sections,
- tables,
- stat blocks.

Implementation guidance

- Avoid parser logic that reads until a loose text pattern happens to match.
- Prefer start/end offsets, page ranges, or source item boundaries that are deterministic.
- A subclass record description should contain only the subclass overview text, not the subclass feature records.
- A magic-item record should stop before the next magic-item heading.
- Feature records should own feature text once, not duplicate it through parent descriptions.
- Preserve existing record ids unless a source item was genuinely missing.

Regression cases

Add tests for:

- subclass:champion does not include Improved Critical or later Champion feature bodies in its subclass description.
- subclass:circle-of-the-land does not include Natural Recovery or later Circle of the Land feature bodies in its subclass description.
- magic-item:feather-token does not include the Figurine of Wondrous Power heading or figurine variants.
- Figurine of Wondrous Power has its own bounded source span, even if actual record emission is completed in the magic-item bead.

Acceptance criteria

- Major record parsers operate on explicit source spans.
- Known subclass and magic-item boundary bleed cases are fixed or fail visibly in tests.
- No existing valid records lose source-backed content.
- Pack generation remains deterministic.
notes: Fixed via PR #194 (branch work/eshyra-4a7.2). parseSubclasses + parseMagicItems now bound bodies at deterministic font-tier heading boundaries (gated on multi-tier slice). Eliminated all 12 swallowed-feature-heading audit findings; Feather Token no longer swallows Figurine of Wondrous Power / Giant Fly. 13 generated records changed (12 subclass descriptions + feather-token), 0 added/removed. verify:dnd5e-srd-pack matches; source-coverage artifacts unchanged (Figurine stays known-gap for 4a7.8). Awaiting review.
